## Foods & dishes
- [[BLEnD]] `Bulgarian_Bulgaria` (SemEval-2026): 105 food questions, 387 answer clusters of everyday food knowledge.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 41 dishes (6 Bulgaria-only; banitsa, bob chorba, lukanka); [[FmLAMA]] 12 dishes (237 rows; kavarma, elenski but); [[World Wide Dishes]] 1 (moussaka). Ingredient lists only.
- No recipes in RecipeDB2, Food.com or CulinaryDB carry a Bulgarian label (only the "Eastern European" region).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 224 plants; [[NPASS]] 189 pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 5 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Bulgarian recipes with ingredients and amounts, and no FCT.
